lines: I press down hard on the accelerator
No games, that's right
Cutting through the night
I'll grind it in at the end
It all balances out to zero, that's right
Wearing away the days
Gently open your heart
And when I pull you close
It'll reach you, surely, flow through you, more and more
Come on
Rushing through life, wringing out everything
On tangled legs alone, farther than before
Farther still, far away
Even if I seize it, snatch it away and hold it
If it isn't you
It means nothing
So more, more, more — to the far beyond

Your world, grown used to pretending
I'll paint it over, white
White
